metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of SomeApp: extends it_1_06 with a PostgreSQL database and developer SSH access to the application server

elements.name: User
elements.description: End user accessing the web application via browser

elements.name: Developer
elements.description: Developer or operator managing the application server via SSH

elements.name: Cloudflare
elements.description: CDN and edge proxy. Terminates HTTPS at the edge (www.someapp.xx) and routes traffic to the origin server

elements.name: SomeApp
elements.description: Public-facing web application. Receives proxied requests from Cloudflare and reads/writes to database and object storage

elements.name: PostgreSQL
elements.description: Primary relational database storing application data

elements.name: Object Storage
elements.description: S3-compatible object storage bucket for application assets and files
